analysisArchitecture.aiContribution: Gemini is the primary educational analyst and creates diagnosis, findings, hypotheses, interventions and monitoring from verified evidence; it does not edit local prose templates
analysisArchitecture.reconciliation: server and client validate evidence references and minimum analytical completeness before any result is shown
analysisArchitecture.routingRule: form type shapes the evidence dossier and analytical lens, but the AI chooses depth and item counts according to the actual evidence

acceptanceCoverage.primaryAiOwnership: diagnosis, findings, hypotheses, interventions and monitoring are generated by Gemini from evidence rather than local prose templates
acceptanceCoverage.localOwnership: data extraction, validation, calculations, metrics, charts and evidence references
acceptanceCoverage.evidenceGate: unknown evidence references are removed server-side and client-side
acceptanceCoverage.minimumResult: normal path: 3 evidence-backed analytical units, 2-3 distinct interventions, 1-2 method checks and exactly 3 monitoring stages; rescue path retains 2 units, 2 interventions and 3 monitoring stages
acceptanceCoverage.variableCounts: normal analysis uses balanced bounded counts; rescue preserves a smaller but still actionable result
acceptanceCoverage.failureBehavior: no official report is shown when the primary AI analysis fails
acceptanceCoverage.cacheBehavior: primary educational analysis is not reused; every run requests a fresh evidence-grounded reading
acceptanceCoverage.nonDuplication: diagnosticAnalysis and decisionFinding are separate fields and near-duplicate text is rejected
acceptanceCoverage.scopeGuard: aggregate score data cannot name a specific skill or concept without item-level evidence

performance.resultsPresentation: results appear only after the primary AI analysis passes evidence validation
performance.networkRequestsPerAnalysis: 1 normally; 2 only when the first output is incomplete or invalid
performance.latencyStrategy: Gemini 3.5 Flash with low thinking, 8192 output headroom, concise non-duplicative fields, and one minimal-thinking rescue that still preserves two interventions and three monitoring stages

backwardCompatibility.legacyEnhanceFastOperation: retained server-side for old clients but unused by v1.0.4
